pr_title: Add Info warning for int return values
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/89315 and https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/89603

Not the happiest with the wording of the error, so any suggestions would be welcome.

Also, I don't love the fact that it needs a MarshalAs attribute to be silenced. Maybe we could use a MSBuild property to silence them? Or should we let the user put the ID in their editorconfig?

issue_context.title: ComInterfaceGenerator should provide an info message when the managed signature returns an int, enum, or type alias for int
issue_context.body: Per the discussions in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/89276, it would help to add a message saying "Hey this returns an int, is that intended to be a [retval] parameter, or the HRESULT (you should use [PreserveSig])?"
